metadata.title: Bentley, Gerhardt & Bates (2008) PLoS Comput. Biol., Hellstrom et al. (2007) Nature & Jakobsson et al. (2010) Nat. Cell Biol. VEGF-VEGFR2-Dll4-Notch1 Tip/Stalk Selection & Angiogenic Sprouting Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Bentley K, Gerhardt H, Bates PA (2008). Agent-based simulation of notch-mediated tip cell selection in angiogenic sprout initialisation. PLoS Computational Biology 4(3):e1000052.
Hellstrom M, Phng LK, Hofmann JJ, et al., Gerhardt H, Betsholtz C (2007). Dll4 signalling through Notch1 regulates formation of tip cells during angiogenesis. Nature 445(7129):776-780.
Jakobsson L, Franco CA, Bentley K, et al., Gerhardt H (2010). Endothelial cells dynamically compete for the tip cell position during angiogenic sprouting. Nature Cell Biology 12(10):943-953.
Chappell JC, Taylor SM, Ferrara N, Bautch VL (2009). Local guidance of emerging vessel sprouts requires soluble Flt-1. Developmental Cell 17(3):377-386.

Collier JR, Monk NAM, Maini PK, Lewis JH (1996). Pattern formation by lateral inhibition with feedback: a mathematical model of delta-notch intercellular signalling. Journal of Theoretical Biology 183(4):429-446.

specimen_metadata.species: Homo sapiens (Human umbilical vein endothelial cells, HUVECs, calcein-AM fluorescence micrograph of angiogenic sprouting vascular network)

governing_equations.brillouin_zone_pi_mode_eigenvalue: lambda_antisym = sqrt(g_D * g_N) - gamma > 0  <=>  g_D * g_N > gamma_D * gamma_N

physiological_salt_and_pepper.phenotype: Well-spaced alternating Tip-Stalk-Tip-Stalk salt-and-pepper vascular sprouting

high_uniform_vegf_oscillations.phenotype: Synchronous anti-phase/in-phase Dll4-Notch oscillations with stunted sprout progression (Bentley et al. 2008 Fig. 5)

dapt_notch_blockade_hypersprouting.phenotype: Pathological 100% all-tip hypersprouting syncytial sheet with collapsed stalk lumen (Hellstrom et al. 2007 Fig. 1)

dll4_haploinsufficiency_heterozygote.phenotype: Dll4+/- haploinsufficient hyperbranching retinal plexus with +50-65% excess filopodial tip density (Hellstrom et al. 2007 Fig. 2)

vegfr2_mosaic_chimeric_competition.phenotype: WT endothelial cells outcompete Vegfr2+/- heterozygous cells for the tip position (~87-90% WT tips, Jakobsson et al. 2010 Fig. 2)
